 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  OR % 22.05.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
Application stands disposed of.
This is an application seeking bail in FIR No. 0445/2022 dated 20.05.2022 registered at PS Khyala u/s 376D/377/328/506/509/34 IPC.

It is stated by Mr. Bhandari, learned counsel for the applicant that in the present case, in the statement u/s 164 Cr.P.C as well as her testimony before the Court, there is no allegation of rape against the applicant, though it is so mentioned in the FIR and the MLC.
For the said reasons, issue notice.
Mr. Utkarsh, learned APP accepts notice.
